kpis.description_fr: Engine Segment = moteurs diesel + gas + alternative fuel pour trucks classe 8 + medium. Coeur historique Cummins.
kpis.description_en: Engine Segment = diesel + gas + alternative fuel engines for class 8 + medium trucks. Cummins' historical core.

kpis.description_fr: Power Systems = générateurs + power gen industriel. Data center tailwind massif (cooling backup). Croissance forte.
kpis.description_en: Power Systems = generators + industrial power gen. Massive data center tailwind (cooling backup). Strong growth.

kpis.description_fr: Components = exhaust + emissions + filtration + automated transmissions (Eaton-Cummins JV). Inclut Atmus spin-off réintégré partiellement.
kpis.description_en: Components = exhaust + emissions + filtration + automated transmissions (Eaton-Cummins JV). Includes partial Atmus spin-off treatment.

kpis.description_fr: Accelera = nouveau segment zero-emission (hydrogen, battery electric, fuel cells). Croissance forte mais petit. Investissement long terme.
kpis.description_en: Accelera = new zero-emission segment (hydrogen, battery electric, fuel cells). Strong growth but small. Long-term investment.

kpis.description_fr: Distribution = vente + service pièces + remanufacturing pour fleet customers. Recurring profitable.
kpis.description_en: Distribution = parts sales + service + remanufacturing for fleet customers. Recurring profitable.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog ~5,5 Mds $, dont gros volume Power Systems data center. Visibilité 6-12 mois.
kpis.description_en: Backlog ~$5.5B, including significant Power Systems data center volume. 6-12 month visibility.
